notes.title: NecroStone - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer Unveiled!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re excited to share the first official gameplay teaser for NecroStone, a dark fantasy action RPG currently in development.

Watch the teaser here:
[previewyoutube=QZTuObAgvOo;full][/previewyoutube]

In NecroStone, you play as a powerful necromancer who gathers monsters and their parts to craft your own unique undead creatures. Engage in brutal melee combat and dark sorcery as you battle through a burning hellscape.

A playable demo is on the way — stay tuned for updates and wishlist the game to follow development!

Thanks,
Team Paragravity
